_help: Towns added to public/data/cities.json from the full GeoNames list (.cache/cities-148k.json) by scripts/cities/add-towns.mjs. Under the map's rules every place with 4,000+ people gets a coin; these sat in land with no community. build-list.mjs keeps them on later runs.

_why.US: Long Island (2026-09-28): the east end (Riverhead, the Hamptons, the Moriches, the North Fork) was more than 25 km from every community, so it had no coin. Every town there with 4,000+ people is added.
